issues.description: The problem statement (and UML) require a constructor that initializes all five attributes (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) in that order, and the solution implements a 5-argument constructor accordingly. However, the template's Lecture class provides only a 3-argument constructor (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents). This constructor-parameter mismatch prevents students from following the specified design and from compiling/tests that expect the five-parameter constructor signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template Lecture constructor signature to include all five parameters in the UML-specified order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Leave the constructor body as a TODO (or assign fields) so students can implement initialization without encountering a signature mismatch.
